- Rick Mears has won the Indianapolis 500 four times (1979, 1984, 1988, 1991).

Based on this information, we can break down the question into simpler subquestions:

2. How many times has Rick Mears won the Indianapolis 500?

Answering these subquestions will help us determine if Rick Mears is the driver on the Penske Racing team who has won the greatest number of Indy 500 races.
